description: This script is a patch for creating salary structure assignments in ERPNext. It performs data reloads, deletions, and updates across salary structures, employees, and company records, and creates new salary structure assignments based on existing data.

classes.name: Salary Structure Assignment
classes.description: A data model representing the assignment of a salary structure to an employee, imported from another module.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to reload documents, delete outdated salary structure assignments, process salary structure details, and create new salary structure assignments accordingly.
